rina: FYI ran the periodic entitlement export; found 11 principals with admin-ish roles on prod analytics and model-serving. 3 are svcaccts, 2 of those have cross-account KMS grants. export: https://redwood.internal/s/exports/entitlement-q2.csv

sec-bot: automated summary: 11 stale admins (>120d), 3 svcacct hits, 2 cross-account KMS grants. flagged for owner outreach.

marc: Can someone paste the minimal commands to inspect GCP/AWS KMS bindings so oncall can triage?

rina: GCP: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/prod-keys/locations/global/keyRings/ml-key/cryptoKeys/serve-key` then look for `serviceAccount:` members. AWS: `aws kms list-grants --key-id <key-id>` and inspect `GranteePrincipal`.

yves: Note: stripping a KMS grant can break decrypts for running jobs. Playbook: 1) outreach owner, 2) preserve grant until owner confirms, 3) schedule rotation+rewrap in maintenance window if removing.

tia: I'll own owner outreach for the two legacy svcaccts (legacy-bridge@, old-ingest@). Legal: any rotation touching customer PII needs signoff; pinged legal.

marc: Ticket template please: include principal, last-auth, last-decrypt log line, key id, suggested 2h off-peak window. Example body: `Principal: legacy-bridge@redwood-prod
LastAuth: 2025-02-10T03:12Z
LastDecrypt: 2024-10-01T22:11Z
Key: projects/prod-keys/.../serve-key
Action: owner confirm -> rotate+rewrap (2h) -> smoke tests`

rina: I'll open tickets and set 5d SLA for owner response. If no reply -> schedule rotation with SRE and infra oncall and post a rollback playbook.

yves: Quick vuln triage note: privilege reduction lowers blast radius for recent client CVE; prioritize svcaccts with >1y inactivity.

tia: Owners contacted, owners asked to respond within 5 days. Whitelist exemptions allowed but expire in 30 days.

sec-bot: thread flagged for monthly compliance digest and will be attached to Q2 audit notes.
